page.layout: One page of running text in a single column; running head at the top, page number at the top right; gathering signature at the bottom right. No marginal notes and no footnotes.

main_text.p: quæque agere non erubescerent. Nec vero mirum est unam & eandem hæresin alio a Græcis, & Latinis nomine vocari, quemadmodum in Helvidianis docuit Augustinus, quos Antidicoma-ritas appellant Græci. Cœpisse vero videtur hoc hominum genus & sœcta post Eunomianos & Patricianos hæreticos, ex quibus utrisque, uti dixi, conflata est sub Arcadio Imperatore, post annum a Christo passo 387. quæ quandiu inter illius ætatis homines fuerit, non est annotatum. Certe nostro sæculo & memoria impurissimus quidam nebulo G. Postellus Sorbonista-rum Parisiensium delicia, hunc blasphemum error em rorem impudenter quidè, sed tamen liberè Lutetiæ renouauit, dixitque nos a Christo ab umbilico tantum ad caput salvos esse factos: reliquas autem nostri partes & inferiores umbilico non a Dei Filio, sed a Ioanna quadam scorto ipsius (quam etiam incestuosus homo matrem suam appellabat) redemptas liberatasque esse. Quale opinionum portentum canem illum etiam publicè in media Academia euomuisse, sciunt omnes, qui eum profitentem Cl. Ptolemæi 100. canonas mecum Lutetiæ audierunt. Paternianis autem adiungunt quidam Symmachianos tanquam eiusdem dogmatis & erroris socios, qui mihi verius & commodius videntur ad Ebionitas vel Photinianos, quorum venena aliis propinarunt, ipsiqúe biberunt, posse referri. Christum enim negarunt Deum esse Deique Filium: sed tantum hominem ex Iosephi mariti & Mariæ coniugis coitu ad cæterorum hominum morem natum, ut scribit Eufeb. lib. 6. cap. 17. Præ-

page.notes: Printed text at the foot: "C.iij." is the gathering signature. "Sorbonista-rum", "Antidicoma-ritas" and "Præ-" are words broken at line ends with a printed hyphen. Doubtful readings: "Deique" (the scan shows an accent-like mark over the i, possibly a printing blur); "Helvidianis" (printed as "Hel" and "uidianis" across a line end without a hyphen, read as one word); "error em rorem" as printed in the line "error em rorem" with a stray space. Long s is transcribed as s throughout; s-ligatures such as "ft" are read as "st". Spelling of u/v and i/j normalised. The page begins mid-paragraph and ends mid-word, so the first paragraph is marked cont="true" and the final word is kept as printed "Præ-".
